review_description: I found Russell easy to deal with and very professional / knowledgeable throughout the installation and commissioning of my system. Russell quoted a fair price to deliver parts and install the system. The application to Horizon Power was very detailed and approved within a week. I am very pleased with the system which so far, has delivered 38 Kwh p/day.I would have no hesitation recommending Russell (Atktec Pty Ltd) It makes such a change to deal with someone who walks the talk !
